verses.en: Moreover thou shalt make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet: with cherubims of cunning work shalt thou make them.
verses.pt: O tabernáculo farás de dez cortinas de linho fino torcido, e de estofo azul, púrpura, e carmesim; com querubins as farás, obra de artífice.
verses.en_web: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains; of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. The work of the skillful workman you shall make them.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make a House for me, with ten curtains of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with designs of winged ones by a good workman.

verses.en: The length of one curtain shall be eight and twenty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and every one of the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.pt: O comprimento de cada cortina será de vinte e oito côvados, e a largura de quatro côvados; todas as cortinas serão da mesma medida.
verses.en_web: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.
verses.en_bbe: Every curtain is to be twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

verses.en: The five curtains shall be coupled together one to another; and other five curtains shall be coupled one to another.
verses.pt: Cinco cortinas serão enlaçadas, cada uma à outra; e as outras cinco serão enlaçadas da mesma maneira.
verses.en_web: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another; and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.
verses.en_bbe: Five curtains are to be joined together, and the other five are to be joined together.

verses.en: And thou shalt make loops of blue upon the edge of the one curtain from the selvedge in the coupling; and likewise shalt thou make in the uttermost edge of another curtain, in the coupling of the second.
verses.pt: Farás laçadas de estofo azul na orla da última cortina do primeiro grupo; assim também farás na orla da primeira cortina do segundo grupo;
verses.en_web: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling; and likewise you shall make in the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to put twists of blue cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group of five, and on the edge of the outside curtain of the second group of five;

verses.en: Fifty loops shalt thou make in the one curtain, and fifty loops shalt thou make in the edge of the curtain that is in the coupling of the second; that the loops may take hold one of another.
verses.pt: a saber, cinqüenta laçadas na orla de uma cortina, e cinqüenta laçadas na orla da outra; as laçadas serão contrapostas uma à outra.
verses.en_web: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.
verses.en_bbe: Fifty twists on one curtain and fifty on the other, the twists to be opposite one another.

verses.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of gold, and couple the curtains together with the taches: and it shall be one tabernacle.
verses.pt: Farás cinqüenta colchetes de ouro, e prenderás com eles as cortinas, uma à outra; assim o tabernáculo virá a ser um todo.
verses.en_web: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps: and the tabernacle shall be a unit.
verses.en_bbe: Then make fifty gold hooks, joining the curtains together by the hooks, and in this way the House will be made.

verses.en: And thou shalt make curtains of goats’ hair to be a covering upon the tabernacle: eleven curtains shalt thou make.
verses.pt: Farás também cortinas de pêlos de cabras para servirem de tenda sobre o tabernáculo; onze destas cortinas farás.
verses.en_web: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make them eleven curtains.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make curtains of goats' hair for a tent over the House, eleven curtains.

verses.en: The length of one curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits: and the eleven curtains shall be all of one measure.
verses.pt: O comprimento de cada cortina será de trinta côvados, e a largura de cada cortina de quatro côvados; as onze cortinas serão da mesma medida.
verses.en_web: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.
verses.en_bbe: Every curtain is to be thirty cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.

verses.en: And thou shalt couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shalt double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.
verses.pt: E ajuntarás cinco cortinas em um grupo, e as outras seis cortinas em outro grupo; e dobrarás a sexta cortina na frente da tenda.
verses.en_web: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.
verses.en_bbe: Five of these curtains are to be joined together, and the other six are to be joined together, the sixth being folded over to make a hanging in front of the tent.

verses.en: And thou shalt make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outmost in the coupling, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain which coupleth the second.
verses.pt: E farás cinqüenta laçadas na orla da última cortina do primeiro grupo, e outras cinqüenta laçadas na orla da primeira cortina do segundo grupo.
verses.en_web: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to put fifty twists of cord on the edge of the outside curtain of one group, and fifty twists on the edge of the outside curtain of the other group.

verses.en: And thou shalt make fifty taches of brass, and put the taches into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.pt: Farás também cinqüenta colchetes de bronze, e meterás os colchetes nas laçadas, e assim ajuntarás a tenda, para que venha a ser um todo.
verses.en_web: You shall make fifty clasps of brass, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.
verses.en_bbe: Then make fifty brass hooks and put the hooks into the twists, joining the tent together to make it one.

verses.en: And the remnant that remaineth of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remaineth, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.
verses.pt: E o resto que sobejar das cortinas da tenda, a saber, a meia cortina que sobejar, penderá aos fundos do tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.
verses.en_bbe: And the folded part which is over of the curtains of the tent, the half-curtain which is folded back, will be hanging down over the back of the House.

verses.en: And a cubit on the one side, and a cubit on the other side of that which remaineth in the length of the curtains of the tent, it shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.pt: E o côvado que sobejar de um lado e de outro no comprimento das cortinas da tenda, penderá de um e de outro lado do tabernáculo, para cobri-lo.
verses.en_web: The cubit on the one side, and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.
verses.en_bbe: And the cubit which is over of the ten curtains at the sides will be hanging over the two sides of the House as a cover.

verses.en: And thou shalt make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering above of badgers skins.
verses.pt: Farás também para a tenda uma coberta de peles de carneiros, tintas de vermelho, e por cima desta uma coberta de peles de golfinhos.
verses.en_web: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.
verses.en_bbe: And then you are to make a cover for the tent, of sheepskins coloured red, and a cover of leather over that.

verses.en: And thou shalt make boards for the tabernacle of shittim wood standing up.
verses.pt: Farás também as tábuas para o tabernáculo de madeira de acácia, as quais serão colocadas verticalmente.
verses.en_web: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make upright boards of hard wood for the House.

verses.en: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.
verses.pt: O comprimento de cada tábua será de dez côvados, e a sua largura de um côvado e meio.
verses.en_web: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.
verses.en_bbe: Every board is to be ten cubits high and a cubit and a half wide.

verses.en: Two tenons shall there be in one board, set in order one against another: thus shalt thou make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.pt: Duas couceiras terá cada tábua, unidas uma à outra por travessas; assim farás com todas as tábuas do tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.
verses.en_bbe: Every board is to be joined to the one nearest to it by two tongues, and so for every board in the House.

verses.en: And thou shalt make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.
verses.pt: Ao fazeres as tábuas para o tabernáculo, farás vinte delas para o lado meridional.
verses.en_web: You shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.
verses.en_bbe: These are the boards needed for the house; twenty boards for the south side,

verses.en: And thou shalt make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for his two tenons, and two sockets under another board for his two tenons.
verses.pt: Farás também quarenta bases de prata debaixo das vinte tábuas; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua, para as suas duas couceiras, e duas bases debaixo de outra, para as duas couceiras dela.
verses.en_web: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.
verses.en_bbe: With forty silver bases under the twenty boards, two bases under every board to take its tongues.

verses.en: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side there shall be twenty boards:
verses.pt: Também para o outro lado do tabernáculo, o que dá para o norte, farás vinte tábuas,
verses.en_web: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,
verses.en_bbe: And twenty boards for the second side of the house on the north,

verses.en: And their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.pt: com as suas quarenta bases de prata; duas bases debaixo de uma tábua e duas debaixo de outra.
verses.en_web: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.en_bbe: With their forty silver bases, two under every board.

verses.en: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward thou shalt make six boards.
verses.pt: E para o lado posterior do tabernáculo, o que dá para o ocidente, farás seis tábuas.
verses.en_web: For the far part of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.
verses.en_bbe: And six boards for the back of the House on the west,

verses.en: And two boards shalt thou make for the corners of the tabernacle in the two sides.
verses.pt: Farás também duas tábuas para os cantos do tabernáculo no lado posterior.
verses.en_web: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.
verses.en_bbe: With two boards for the angles of the House at the back.

verses.en: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it unto one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.pt: Por baixo serão duplas, do mesmo modo se estendendo inteiras até a primeira argola em cima; assim se fará com as duas tábuas; elas serão para os dois cantos.
verses.en_web: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.
verses.en_bbe: The two are to be joined together at the base and at the top to one ring, forming the two angles.

verses.en: And they shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.pt: Haverá oito tábuas com as suas dezesseis bases de prata: duas bases debaixo de uma tábua e duas debaixo de outra.
verses.en_web: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.
verses.en_bbe: So there are to be eight boards, with their sixteen silver bases, two bases under every board.

verses.en: And thou shalt make bars of shittim wood; five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.pt: Farás também travessões de madeira de acácia; cinco para as tábuas de um lado do tabernáculo,
verses.en_web: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,
verses.en_bbe: And make rods of the same wood, five for the boards on the one side,

verses.en: And five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.
verses.pt: e cinco para as tábuas do outro lado do tabernáculo, bem como c6 azeite para a luz, especiarias para o óleo da unção e para o para o ocidente.
verses.en_web: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far part westward.
verses.en_bbe: And five for the boards on the other side of the House, and five for the west side of the House at the back.

verses.en: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.
verses.pt: O travessão central passará ao meio das tábuas, de uma extremidade à outra.
verses.en_web: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.
verses.en_bbe: And the middle rod is to go through the rings of all the boards from end to end.

verses.en: And thou shalt overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and thou shalt overlay the bars with gold.
verses.pt: E cobrirás de ouro as tábuas, e de ouro farás as suas argolas, como lugares para os travessões; também os travessões cobrirás de ouro.
verses.en_web: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars: and you shall overlay the bars with gold.
verses.en_bbe: And the boards are to be plated with gold, having gold rings for the rods to go through: and the rods are to be plated with gold.

verses.en: And thou shalt rear up the tabernacle according to the fashion thereof which was shewed thee in the mount.
verses.pt: Então levantarás o tabernáculo conforme o modelo que te foi mostrado no monte.
verses.en_web: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make the House from the design which you saw on the mountain.

verses.en: And thou shalt make a vail of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen of cunning work: with cherubims shall it be made:
verses.pt: Farás também um véu de azul, púrpura, carmesim, e linho fino torcido; com querubins, obra de artífice, se fará;
verses.en_web: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. The work of the skillful workman shall it be made.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make a veil of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with designs of winged ones by a good workman:

verses.en: And thou shalt hang it upon four pillars of shittim wood overlaid with gold: their hooks shall be of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.
verses.pt: e o suspenderás sobre quatro colunas de madeira de acácia, cobertas de ouro; seus colchetes serão de ouro, sobre quatro bases de prata.
verses.en_web: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.
verses.en_bbe: Hanging it by gold hooks from four pillars of wood, plated with gold and fixed in silver bases.

verses.en: And thou shalt hang up the vail under the taches, that thou mayest bring in thither within the vail the ark of the testimony: and the vail shall divide unto you between the holy place and the most holy.
verses.pt: Pendurarás o véu debaixo dos colchetes, e levarás para dentro do véu a arca do testemunho; este véu vos fará separação entre o lugar santo e o santo dos santos.
verses.en_web: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil: and the veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to put up the veil under the hooks, and put inside it the ark of the law: the veil is to be a division between the holy place and the most holy.

verses.en: And thou shalt put the mercy seat upon the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.pt: Porás o propiciatório sobre a arca do testemunho no santo dos santos;
verses.en_web: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the testimony in the most holy place.
verses.en_bbe: You are to put the cover on the ark of the law, inside the most holy place.

verses.en: And thou shalt set the table without the vail, and the candlestick over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and thou shalt put the table on the north side.
verses.pt: colocarás a mesa fora do véu, e o candelabro defronte da mesa, para o lado sul do tabernáculo; e porás a mesa para o lado norte.
verses.en_web: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south: and you shall put the table on the north side.
verses.en_bbe: And outside the veil you are to put the table, and the support for the lights opposite the table on the south side of the House; and the table is to be on the north side.

verses.en: And thou shalt make an hanging for the door of the tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, wrought with needlework.
verses.pt: Farás também para a porta da tenda um reposteiro de azul, púrpura, carmesim: e linho fino torcido, obra de bordador.
verses.en_web: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.
verses.en_bbe: And you are to make a curtain for the doorway of the Tent, of the best linen with needlework of blue and purple and red.

verses.en: And thou shalt make for the hanging five pillars of shittim wood, and overlay them with gold, and their hooks shall be of gold: and thou shalt cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.pt: E para o reposteiro farás cinco colunas de madeira de acácia, cobrindo-as de ouro (os seus colchetes também serão de ouro), e para elas fundirás cinco bases de bronze.
verses.en_web: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold: their hooks shall be of gold: and you shall cast five sockets of brass for them.
verses.en_bbe: And make five pillars for the curtain, of hard wood plated with gold; their hooks are to be of gold and their bases of brass
